# Signet Contacts for Rust

> Rust consumer-side wire library for Signet Contacts v2 pairing, acknowledgements, encrypted vault envelopes and projections.

## Documentation

- [Rust integration](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-contacts-rs/blob/main/README.md): Cargo naming, supported operations and conformance checks.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-contacts-rs): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
- [signet-contacts-conformance](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-contacts-conformance): Shared v2 fixtures for cross-language compatibility.
